ask.question: Why do sign-ups stall on Oct 9?
ask.answer: Between 02:00 and 10:00 UTC on Oct 9, 72% of sessions at the OTP code screen ended there, against 5% outside the window (535 sessions inside it). 71% of them showed rage taps. The pattern is the same for every persona, which points to codes not being delivered rather than user behavior.

ask.question: Can I trust this data?
